cues.en: Hello, hello, let's continue. The second one is about the concurrent workflow. Let's see how that stuff works.
cues.zh: 大家好，繼續第二種，也就是 Concurrent 並行工作流程，看看它如何運作。

cues.en: I already created a console application for the concurrent workflow demo.
cues.zh: 我已經建立 ConcurrentWorkflowDemo 主控台專案。

cues.en: Let's first of all bring in the correct name NuGet packages in here.
cues.zh: 先加入正確的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And again, like the previous one, it's identical. I'm bringing in the AI workflows 1.1 and of course the agent framework itself. That's all
cues.zh: 和前一個範例完全相同，加入 AI.Workflows 1.1，當然還有 Agent Framework 本身，以及，

cues.en: the user secrets, the extensions and the Azure AI OpenAI. All right, let me save all of this and I'm going to go ahead and bring the code for the concurrent to show you.
cues.zh: User Secrets、Extensions 與 Azure.AI.OpenAI。儲存後，加入並行範例的程式碼。

cues.en: Open up program.cs, delete all that mumbo-jumbo.
cues.zh: 開啟 Program.cs，刪除範本。

cues.en: All right, let me bring in the code and let's explain it line by line in here. It's not going to be very different.
cues.zh: 貼入程式碼，再逐行解釋，其實差異不大。

cues.en: Again, I'm going to bring in the endpoint and the API key from my Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 同樣從 Microsoft Foundry 取得端點與 API 金鑰。

cues.en: I'm going to create a client against the Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 建立 AzureOpenAIClient。

cues.en: I'm going to decide on using GPT-5 for the iChat client interface and then I'm going to create two agents.
cues.zh: IChatClient 選擇 GPT-5，接著建立兩個代理程式。

cues.en: One is a legal agent, okay?
cues.zh: 一個是 LegalAgent。

cues.en: And the instructions for the legal agent is that you're a legal agent that need to evaluate if a text is legal and use a maximum of 250 characters to do that.
cues.zh: 指示是：你是一位法律代理程式，評估文字是否合法，最多使用 250 個字元回答。

cues.en: All right. The other one is a spelling error agent. If there is any spelling in the text I'm going to be passing you as an input, I need you to bring this up.
cues.zh: 另一個是拼字錯誤代理程式，檢查輸入文字是否有任何拼字錯誤，若有就指出。

cues.en: So the question that you have to ask is does this actually need to be sequential or can each one of those be completely done on a separate thread pretty much at the same time? And the fact is it is.
cues.zh: 這時應該問，兩者需要循序執行嗎？還是可以各自在不同執行緒同時完成？答案是可以同時。

cues.en: So notice there is another agent workflow builder called build concurrent. We already used the build sequence one, sequential one. So this build
cues.zh: 因此 AgentWorkflowBuilder 還有 BuildConcurrent。前面使用過 BuildSequential，這裡，

cues.en: concurrent, notice I'm not passing the names with a comment between them. It's an array.
cues.zh: BuildConcurrent 傳入的不是單純以逗號排列的參數，而是陣列。

cues.en: That is the biggest difference. An array I can add three, four, five different ones in here.
cues.zh: 這是最大的寫法差異，可以加入三、四、五個代理程式。

cues.en: The thing is you are not guaranteed that the first one will run first.
cues.zh: 但無法保證第一個元素一定先執行。

cues.en: So if I run this like five times, maybe the legal agent will run maybe twice first, but the other three times the spelling error agents will start first. There is no way to guarantee which one will start.
cues.zh: 假設執行五次，也許兩次 LegalAgent 先開始，另外三次拼字代理程式先開始，沒有保證。

cues.en: They're all going to be randomly started and a lot of times, believe it or not, the spelling error agent will be the one that will start. We don't care as long as they're both running at the same time, not sequential.
cues.zh: 開始順序可能不同，很多時候拼字代理程式會先跑。但只要同時執行、不是循序，就不在意。

cues.en: So think about it, for instance, the example of trying to get a cheap ticket from Orlando in Florida to Heathrow Airport in London.
cues.zh: 例如想找佛羅里達奧蘭多飛往倫敦希斯洛機場的便宜機票，

cues.en: There are a lot of companies that offer that using API, something like Expedia and Travelocity and Priceline.
cues.zh: 許多公司都有 API，例如 Expedia、Travelocity 與 Priceline。

cues.en: There is no reason for me to do this sequential.
cues.zh: 沒有理由循序查詢。

cues.en: So I can add the agent for each and every single one of these providers and I can tell it what my request is and they can all be working on it at the same time.
cues.zh: 可以為每個供應商建立代理程式，提供相同要求，讓它們同時處理。

cues.en: The only problem that you need, I don't know if it's a problem or not, but you will not see the output until the slowest one of all three comes back.
cues.zh: 唯一要注意，不確定算不算問題，是最後輸出要等三者中最慢的回來。

cues.en: So they all have to come back.
cues.zh: 所以全部都必須完成。

cues.en: So maybe one will come back in one second, one will come back in two seconds, and another one will take 30 seconds.
cues.zh: 也許一個一秒、一個兩秒，另一個三十秒。

cues.en: Well, in that case, we are not going to get the final answer until all three come back.
cues.zh: 這種情況，必須等三個都回來，才取得最終答案。

cues.en: That means we're going to have to wait for 30 seconds. That's the main idea in here as well.
cues.zh: 也就是要等三十秒，這是主要概念。

cues.en: That doesn't mean that you are not going to see the answers coming in from each one of the agents in the workflow one by one, but the final output
cues.zh: 並不表示無法逐一看到工作流程中各代理程式的答案，但完整的最後輸出，

cues.en: will not be done until the last agent comes back from the executors themselves. Makes sense?
cues.zh: 要等最後一個 Executor 完成。理解嗎？

cues.en: That is the same patent doc that I used in the previous example in here, folks.
cues.zh: 這裡使用和前一個範例相同的專利文件。

cues.en: Just some text. And remember, I'm going to go ahead and I'm going to ask you, you're a legal agent that needs to evaluate if a text is legal.
cues.zh: 只是文字。記得 LegalAgent 的任務是評估文件是否合法。

cues.en: So we're going to see this and make sure that this is legal. Plus the other one will look at the same exact text at the same time and see if there is any spelling in it whatsoever. Okay?
cues.zh: 它會檢查這些內容；另一個代理程式同時查看完全相同文字，找出拼字錯誤。

cues.en: Again, I'm not going to go through the three different processes that we go through. It's almost the same every time, which is the in-process execution for runStreamingAsync, passing the workflow and the messages.
cues.zh: 這裡不再重複三個主要流程，因為幾乎每次相同：InProcessExecution.RunStreamingAsync，傳入工作流程與訊息。

cues.en: I'm going to start executing the first one randomly. We don't know which one is going to run, but the token will be the one that will invoke the first executor.
cues.zh: TurnToken 會開始執行第一批 Executor，但無法預測哪個先啟動。

cues.en: And then we're going to listen in by emitting the events equal to true.
cues.zh: 接著設定 EmitEvents = true，接收事件。

cues.en: From that point on, I'm going to go into a loop and I'm going to be listening or watching for the streamAsync.
cues.zh: 再進入迴圈，透過 WatchStreamAsync 監聽。

cues.en: And I'm only interested when each and every single one of the agent is completed. So workflow, output, event in here. And I'm going to end up putting all the stuff in an array called result.
cues.zh: 目前只關心每個代理程式完成的輸出，因此處理 WorkflowOutputEvent，再放入 Result 陣列。

cues.en: And if I would like to show all of the stuff at the end, I'm going to go through all of the different messages inside of this result.
cues.zh: 最後想顯示結果，就遍歷 Result 中的所有訊息。

cues.en: I'm not interested in the user one. I'm only interested in the assistant one, which is the answers coming back from the LLM.
cues.zh: 不關心 user，只關心 assistant，也就是 LLM 的回答。

cues.en: And what I'm going to write out, I'm going to write the name of the executor.
cues.zh: 輸出時，也顯示 Executor 的名稱，

cues.en: So it could be the legal one or it could be the spelling one.
cues.zh: 因此可能是 LegalAgent，或拼字代理程式。

cues.en: I want to see which one actually ran and what message did it bring. Does that make sense?
cues.zh: 想知道誰執行了，以及回傳什麼訊息。理解嗎？

cues.en: That's what a concurrent is all about. As a matter of fact, I'm going to run it twice so you can see that hopefully, with my luck, it will not be the same one running first every single time.
cues.zh: 這就是並行。我會執行兩次，希望運氣不錯，能看到每次不是同一個先開始。

cues.en: So let's see. We'll make sure we save first.
cues.zh: 先確認儲存。

cues.en: And here we'll say dot net run.
cues.zh: 再執行 dotnet run。

cues.en: And let's make this a little bit bigger and see, now that both of them are running at the same time, what will be the output based on going the for each,
cues.zh: 把畫面放大，現在兩者同時執行，看看透過 foreach，

cues.en: based on that event, which is the workflow output event coming back.
cues.zh: 處理 WorkflowOutputEvent 後，會得到什麼輸出。

cues.en: All right, and it came back. See, because I told it here, give me the author name, that means the name of the executor, legal agent hit first. And that's by coincidence, even though,
cues.zh: 結果出來了。因為要求顯示 AuthorName，也就是 Executor 名稱，可以看到這次 LegalAgent 先回來，純粹巧合，

cues.en: okay, I'm going to run it again, and I'm hoping that spelling error will run the next one.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，希望下次拼字代理程式先完成。

cues.en: The legal agent said the generally lawful patent license terms, risk, vague, governing law, and so on. So give its opinion about this couple of paragraphs that I gave it.
cues.zh: LegalAgent 說這些大致是合法的專利授權條款，但準據法等內容較模糊，對提供的段落給出意見。

cues.en: Also, the spelling error agent did not find any spelling errors at all in the text whatsoever.
cues.zh: 拼字代理程式則沒有發現任何拼字錯誤。

cues.en: All right, let's go ahead and be a little bit nasty. I'm going to maybe remove the E.
cues.zh: 那我們故意弄錯一點，移除一個 E，

cues.en: So the word agreement is misspelled. We'll say save this guy, and let's go ahead and run it again. Hopefully, based on our good luck,
cues.zh: 讓 agreement 拼錯。儲存，再跑一次，希望這次，

cues.en: it will not be the legal agent that will run this time. We don't know. Sometimes I have to run it three or four times to get the spelling one to start first. Maybe we'll see if I'm lucky this
cues.zh: 不是 LegalAgent 先執行。無法確定，有時得跑三、四次，拼字代理程式才先開始。看看這次，

cues.en: time. I am lucky. Look at that. The spelling error agent actually ran first. And it says spelling correction agreement should be agreement with double E. All other terms are spelled
cues.zh: 運氣很好，拼字代理程式先跑，指出 agreement 應該有兩個 E，其他詞彙都，

cues.en: correctly. And then the legal agent gave us exactly the summarization under 250 words to tell us if this was a legal document or not. Isn't that pretty cool? That's what a concurrent
cues.zh: 拼對了。接著 LegalAgent 也在長度限制內，總結這是否為合法文件。很酷吧？這就是 Concurrent，

cues.en: workflow means in the agent framework. Hopefully, you like that, and you have a better understanding between the sequential and the concurrent, how they work, and how you can
cues.zh: 工作流程。希望你喜歡，也更理解 Sequential 與 Concurrent 的差異、運作方式，以及如何，

cues.en: use them. And I really can't wait to see a lot of people doing some very creative things using these workflow patterns in the future. All right, let's move on to the next one.
cues.zh: 使用。我非常期待看到大家用這些模式創造有趣功能。接著下一個單元。
